om: The themes of the treasure hunt, written for rusj.no. start: the first card per age (4, 7, 10). innled: short calls before the clues. skatt: the card at the treasure. koder: code words (o) and pictures (i) – the pictures are for the youngest.

start.4: Ahoy, little pirates! The captain has hidden some treasure. Here is your first clue:
start.7: Ahoy, shipmates! Captain Bristlebeard has hidden a chest full of gold. Follow the clues and you'll find it!
start.10: Ahoy! An old treasure map has been found. Whoever solves every riddle will find the captain's chest.

skatt.tekst: You found the captain's treasure chest. Share the loot fairly, pirates!
skatt.kort: Well done, pirates! You found the treasure. Share it fairly with the whole crew!

start.4: Hello, astronauts! A spaceship has lost its treasure. Here is your first clue:
start.7: Mission control to the crew: treasure from a faraway planet has landed in our home. Find it!
start.10: Mission control reports: an alien has hidden a treasure and sent us secret messages. Crack them all!

skatt.tekst: Mission complete. Mission control salutes the whole crew!
skatt.kort: Mission complete! You found the space treasure. Welcome home, astronauts!

start.4: Hello, little detectives! Somebody has hidden a treasure. Here is your first clue:
start.7: Hello, detectives! A treasure has gone missing, and someone has left clues. Can you solve the mystery?
start.10: Top secret case: a treasure has vanished. Follow the clues, crack the riddles and solve the case!

skatt.tekst: You found the missing treasure. Well done, detectives!
skatt.kort: Case closed! You found the treasure. Well done, detectives!

start.4: Rooaar! A dinosaur has hidden its egg. Here is your first clue:
start.7: Rooaar! A friendly dinosaur has lost its egg. Follow the tracks and find it before it hatches!
start.10: 66 million years ago, a treasure was buried. Now the tracks have been found – follow them!

skatt.tekst: You found the prehistoric treasure. The dinosaur is proud of you!
skatt.kort: Rooaar! You found the dino treasure. Well done, dino hunters!

start.4: Once upon a time, a troll hid a treasure. Here is your first clue:
start.7: Once upon a time, a troll stole the king's treasure. Only the bravest children can find it again!
start.10: Once upon a time, a troll took the king's treasure and hid it. Solve the riddles and live happily ever after.

skatt.tekst: And they all lived happily ever after. The end!
skatt.kort: You found the troll's treasure! And they all lived happily ever after.

start.4: Hello, little explorers! The monkeys have hidden some treasure in the jungle. Here is your first clue:
start.7: Welcome to the jungle! The monkeys have taken the treasure and hidden it. Follow the clues!
start.10: The expedition starts now. Somewhere in the jungle lies a forgotten treasure – and only the brave will find it.

skatt.tekst: The expedition was a success. The monkeys are clapping for you!
skatt.kort: Hooray! You found the jungle treasure. The monkeys are clapping for you!
